name: HG Metals
old_description: Embark on a journey of excellence with our distinguished construction and installation services, where every project is executed with unparalleled precision and a commitment to enduring quality. Experience a fusion of innovative techniques and timeless craftsmanship, tailored to transform your visions into reality.
about:
HG Metals, a structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication company, operates from Indianapolis, Indiana. It functions as an active division of HGMC Supply, Inc., with Ashley Collins serving as president and owner. The business was established over two decades ago to provide steel solutions for commercial and construction projects across Indiana and the United States.

The company fabricates structural steel framing, support systems, custom stairs, rails, ladders, mezzanines, equipment platforms, canopies, and specialty metal items. Its Indianapolis facility is equipped with modern CNC machinery and staffed by AWS D1.1‑certified welders. HG Metals maintains membership in the American Institute of Steel Construction (AISC) and adheres to NAAMM and NOMMA guidelines, producing all work in‑house and shipping nationwide.

Primary customers are general contractors, developers, and commercial construction firms. Recent projects include structural steel packages for large‑scale commercial developments and one‑of‑a‑kind custom fabrications for specialty builds. The firm serves clients throughout Indiana and across the United States.

HG Metals emphasizes clear communication, dependable scheduling, and accountability from bid through final delivery. Leadership states that their differentiation lies in building relationships, solving problems, and keeping steel on the critical path of each project.
